Purpose: Banner for a post on cognitive surrender and intent review: people investigate a discrepancy despite a reassuring automated approval.

Build.LowerBody: Full hips and thighs, assertive stance

Face.Complexion: Fair-light skin with cool highlights and cinematic contrast

Situation.Name: Questioning the green light
Situation.Setting: A cyberpunk collaborative systems workshop at night. A shared physical worktable faces an open window onto a lived-in city. Two colleagues stand across the table from the recurring silver-haired woman. The scene is an investigation together, with automation operating in the background.
Situation.Camera: Wide cinematic banner, eye-level three-quarter view across the table. Silver-haired woman on left third, shared evidence and a single visible discrepancy in centre, colleagues on right. Keep all essential faces and actions in the central horizontal band for a 16:9 crop of the 1536x1024 canvas.

CharacterPose.Expression: Alert, questioning concentration, engaged with a colleague rather than staring at code
CharacterPose.BodyPosition: Standing at the shared table, shoulders open toward the other people
CharacterPose.Gesture: One hand indicates the point where an amber evidence path diverges from a cyan projected intent path; the other rests on the table. Natural anatomy and gestures.

Character.Name: Dark blazer
Character.Description: Professional black blazer with sleeves pushed up over a subtle futuristic fitted top

Article.Name: Automated approval display
Article.Description: One translucent background panel with a prominent lime-green checkmark and faint orderly abstract rows; no readable text or code
Article.Application: Behind and above the table, visually secondary, still green while the discrepancy is examined
Article.SymbolicMeaning: A persuasive clean result does not settle whether the assumptions hold

Article.Name: Shared intent and evidence map
Article.Description: A restrained tabletop projection of a few connected cyan paths. One amber path from a physical evidence card enters from outside and visibly diverges at a single junction. Large simple geometry readable at thumbnail size
Article.Application: Centre foreground, directly between the people, discrepancy indicated by the woman
Article.SymbolicMeaning: External evidence challenges an internally coherent system of intents

Article.Name: Evidence card
Article.Description: A physical card bearing a simple abstract journey trace, no words or numerical claims
Article.Application: A colleague places it beside the projection and points to its divergent path
Article.SymbolicMeaning: Support and observations of actual usage enter the intent review

Environment.Name: Shared worktable
Environment.Description: Dark brushed metal, tactile edges, uncluttered surface
Environment.Application: Spans the foreground and physically connects the people

Environment.Name: Colleagues
Environment.Description: Two adult colleagues with distinct appearances, ordinary professional tech clothing, attentive expressions
Environment.Application: Across the table, one contributing the evidence card, the other following the discussion; no passive audience

Environment.Name: Open city-facing window
Environment.Description: Distant occupied city with warm window lights, atmospheric depth
Environment.Application: Background right, conveys the world beyond the local model

KeyDetails: People examine a disagreement while the automated status stays green.
Do not depict manual line-by-line code review, robots, vendor branding, Alloy branding, tool logos, or a dashboard collage.
One focal discrepancy; no mass of floating panels or tangled connections.
No title, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, fake metrics, or fabricated code.
Keep character likeness consistent with repository character reference photographs.
Main character and colleagues remain active collaborators; no sleep, hypnosis, or helpless surrender imagery.
Situation.LightingFocus: Cool cyan projection and restrained magenta rim light, warm amber from the evidence card reflected on faces and hands. Green approval stays in softer background focus. Dramatic but readable faces.

ArticleContext.Title: What are you hiring code reviews to do?
Themes: External evidence can challenge shared assumptions
Automation continues while people review intent
